derivation: from a compound of G4862 (σύν) and G1586 (ἐκλέγομαι);
def: chosen in company with, i.e. co-elect (fellow Christian)

occurrences.text: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
